decisive_items: A 55-year-old man underwent right hemicolectomy for moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma of the ascending colon
Thirteen months after surgery, follow-up CT revealed a 25 mm lesion in segment 8 of the liver
response.rationale: History of colorectal cancer and new liver lesion suggests metastasis, despite some features also consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma

rejected.why: Lack of typical hepatocellular carcinoma risk factors and absence of significantly elevated tumor markers
